chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But [He granted authority] over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/ally

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) clarification that Satan’s *sultan* (authority) is not inherent but contingent upon human free will and voluntary submission, a key distinction in Shia theology against predestination. This teaching underscores that true faith (*iman*) acts as a shield against Satanic dominion, while persistent disobedience grants him leverage, reinforcing the concept of *al-wala' wa al-barra'* in spiritual struggle.
